mapper.select: SELECT t.type, COALESCE(unread.unreadCount, 0) AS unreadCount FROM (SELECT DISTINCT mn.type FROM sys_message_notice mn) t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT mn.type, COUNT(mu.id) AS unreadCount FROM sys_message_notice mn LEFT JOIN sys_message_user mu ON mn.msg_id = mu.msg_id AND mu.read_status = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_message_info mi ON mi.id = mn.msg_id AND mi.`status` = 1 AND mi.publish_time <= NOW() WHERE mi.tenant_id = #{condition.tenantId} AND mu.user_id = #{condition.userId} GROUP BY mn.type ) unread ON t.type = unread.type ORDER BY t.type
